## Summary

Describe the existing behavior being fixed or maintained and why this is the smallest appropriate change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` when extension behavior changes
- [ ] New or updated regression coverage where applicable

## Safety review

- [ ] No secrets, CV/job content, tokens, or provider payloads are logged or committed
- [ ] Privacy policy/provider disclosures remain accurate
- [ ] Existing API and extension behavior is preserved unless the change explicitly fixes incorrect behavior
